messages:
lina: Quick heads-up — Hosted API: Cascade model family + Toolcall v2 (streaming function frames) are GA in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Docs live at https://console.redwood.ai/docs/hosted/toolcall-v2 — please read before upgrading :tada:

matt: Nice! What's the migration story for existing v1 tool-calls? Any breaking changes to worry about?

lina: Short version: minor changes. v1 clients will continue to work for 60 days but we strongly recommend moving to v2. Main change: v2 streams function-call frames and supports incremental tool outputs. Example request body to opt in:
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "cascade-1-x",
  "tool_call": "v2-stream",
  "stream": true
}
```
Response stream yields JSON frames prefixed by `data:`. Full examples are in the docs.

saira: Do we have fallback behavior if a tool fails mid-stream? Need guidance for customers.

lina: Yes — runtime will emit a terminal error frame and automatically attempt fallback to the pinned model variant if configured. We recommend adding an idempotency token on tool actions. Also note the new per-connection idle timeout (120s) and per-connection token quota for streaming endpoints. We'll email tenants that look impacted.

matt: Are there any policy or quota changes that apps should be aware of?

lina: Small quota change for streaming: streaming connections count toward a new "stream-conn" quota and have a separate token bucket. This helps protect tail latency under noisy neighbors. No immediate change for most customers; metric thresholds and emails will go out to teams >100k tokens/mo.

devrel: I'll put together migration samples (Node/Python) and a cheat-sheet. Planning a workshop next Tue 10am PT to walk internal teams + selected customers through upgrading. @ops-bot can you start a 10% canary for v2?

ops-bot: Canary rollout initiated for Toolcall v2 in us-west-2 at 10% traffic. Monitoring hooks: latency_p95, tool_errors, stream_disconnects. Alerts will route to eng-runtime.

matt: Need a short blurb for support & marketing so external comms are consistent. Also flag any known regressions.

lina: Marketing blurb (one-liner): "Cascade + Toolcall v2 GA — low-latency streaming function-calls and lower e2e cost for interactive ops." Support playbook: internal doc `/docs/internal/toolcall-v2-playbook` (will add runbook snippets and troubleshooting checklist). Known regression: very large single-tool payloads (>=1MB) may see a slight buffering increase; flagged to runtime team.

saira: I'll add a Console banner and send targeted emails to enterprise tenants tomorrow AM.

devrel: PR created with sample clients and RFC link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/322 — adding migration notes and testing checklist.

ops-bot: Post-deploy health checks: all green after 30 minutes. No elevated error rates observed.

lina: Thanks team. I'll post a short follow-up with the deprecation timeline: v1 toolcall deprecated in 60 days, disabled in 120 days. We'll keep the canary running while we watch feedback. :rocket:
